_contract: A fixed seed and a committed input must give this output. If this file needs to change, say why in the commit message - a diff here is a change in what the software computes.
_what: Multivariate > Segmentation, RFM on the repository's sample_customers.csv

segments.profile: Recent, frequent, high-spending customers — your best customers.
Long time since last purchase, low frequency and spend — likely churned.
High frequency/spend but haven't purchased as recently — worth re-engaging.
Purchased recently but haven't built up frequency or spend yet.
Buy regularly and recently, with solid spend — reliable repeat customers.
Middling on recency, frequency, and spend — neither strong nor lost.
Used to buy often and spend a lot, but haven't purchased in a while — winnable back.
